reflection.review:
8 of 8 planned attempts implemented, prechecked, and scored under the v2
optimization-mode gate (leaderboard, no pass/fail; two fixed targets at 90 s
each; records seeded by best-of-3 reference runs including the
schedule-hygiene variant). 4 of 8 set confirmed records at their scoring
time; final records vs the reference seeds:

- **reg3_250: 44.29 → 39.95** (attempt-015; −4.34 log2 ≈ 20× fewer flops)
- **sycamore_m20: 71.17 → 61.51** (attempt-018; −9.66 log2 ≈ 800× fewer flops)

Per attempt (kind, parent, scored tc reg3/syc, one-line causal claim):

- 011 improve/001, 40.16/61.73: first scorer — smashed both reference
  records (+4.13/+9.44), set the bar the siblings then chased.
- 012 improve/008, 40.29/62.05: ties 011 within noise; projection ≈ hard
  rejection in outcome.
- 013 draft, 43.45/72.00: simplification preprocessing **refuted** — with
  the optimizer held at baseline, pre-absorbing sycamore's 106 rank-1
  vectors gained ≈ nothing over the reference (72.0 vs 71.17 seed).
- 014 draft, 45.04/66.06: LNS scored far below its own 90 s smoke tests
  (40.3/62.2) — did not replicate under the validator.
- 015 draft, **39.95**/61.80: evolutionary replica population — new
  confirmed records on both instances.
- 016 draft, 45.12/67.08: tabu — its own predicted 1-in-5 reg3 upper tail
  hit on the scored run; also behind SA on sycamore.
- 017 draft, 39.95/**61.57**: exact-penalty λ-ramp — new confirmed sycamore
  record; reg3 tie with 015's record to 0.001.
- 018 draft, 40.02/**61.51**: memetic pipeline — final sycamore record;
  its own DP component measured inert (gain ≈ 0.002).

Zero sc-cap violations, zero rejections, zero timeouts across 16 scored
instances (every mechanism handled sc explicitly — cycle 1's lesson held).
Budget: 8/8 attempts used; authorized_rounds now 0; 2 debug slots unused.
No overrides this cycle.
reflection.evidence:
- Confirmed records: reg3_250 tc 39.95 sc 34 (015), sycamore_m20 tc 61.51
  sc 53 (018); every record double-run confirmed under fresh relabeling.
- Five-mechanism convergence to the same basins suggests 39.9/61.5 is near
  the sc-constrained optimum reachable by local search at this budget —
  further move-set variations are unlikely to move records much
  (diminishing-returns warning for more same-family attempts).
- Blacklist additions: simplification preprocessing as a quality lever
  (013); single-run high-variance methods without internal
  restart-min (014, 016 as scored).
- Standing risk: records measured against omeco-only references; external
  SOTA (cotengra) not yet on the board.
reflection.literature:
`sc_target = cap` as the operative annealing objective matches the
memory-bounded practice in [kalachev_2021_multi] (β-penalty on
log2(M/Mmax) overflow) — our finding sharpens it: on instances whose
optimum sits near the cap, target-the-cap dominates target-a-low-sc. The
five-way basin convergence at matched budget echoes the plateau behavior
described in [gray_2020_hyper]'s anytime curves. No paper in `.knowledge/`
reports the specific failure mode "default sc_target sabotages TreeSA on
high-sc-optimum instances" — novel at the library/engineering level; the
record-sized quality gains need a cotengra head-to-head before any
external claim. Shelved insights: none (all Selected).
reflection.next:
Falsifiable hypothesis for a cycle 3, if authorized: "the 39.9/61.5 basins
are near the local-search limit; breaking below requires either external
reference pressure (cotengra rows may reveal deeper basins exist) or
global-structure methods on sycamore's layered geometry." Sketch: (1) add
cotengra SA + KaHyPar reference rows (measurement, not an attempt); (2)
one improve on 015 and one on 017 (unify: population + λ-ramp, the two
best-variance mechanisms); (3) repeated-scoring debug of 014 to settle its
variance question; (4) a sycamore-specific draft exploiting circuit
layering (cut along time slices). Abandon the move-set direction if (2)
gains < 0.2 on both targets — that would confirm the basin-limit
hypothesis and shift effort to new instance families or to merging the
finding into omeco. Also proposed for the gate: fold the `sc_target=cap`
principle into the omeco library (PR to `treesa.rs`), independent of
further cycles.

lessons.observation: five mechanically different searches landed within 0.35 log2 of each other on both targets, ~4.3/~9.7 below the TreeSA references
lessons.root_cause: the gain comes from the shared objective change — sc_target = cap instead of omeco's default 20 — plus full-budget anytime annealing; the default target drags search toward low-memory/high-flop trees on instances whose optimum sits at sc 33-53
lessons.evidence: 018's ablation (soft penalty at cap: reg3 56.8 -> 40.0, its DP gained 0.002); the 0.35-wide five-way cluster; references measured at default sc_target
lessons.implication: publishable object is the sc-budget-aware annealing principle, not a move set; fix omeco TreeSA's default sc_target footgun in the library

lessons.observation: 014 and 016 scored 4-5 log2 worse than their own smoke tests; the SA family replicated to within 0.1
lessons.root_cause: heavy-tailed run-to-run variance in LNS/tabu; a single scored run samples the tail, while SA-family methods are intrinsically low-variance
lessons.evidence: 016's LOG documents a 1-in-5 tail incl. 45.1; 014 smoke 40.3 vs scored 45.0
lessons.implication: variance is a first-class quality axis; high-variance mechanisms need internal restart-and-min to compete per single run

lessons.observation: simplification preprocessing (013) gained nothing despite 106 rank-1 tensors on sycamore
lessons.root_cause: TreeSA spends negligible budget on trivially-decidable contractions; search-space size was not the binding constraint
lessons.evidence: 013 held the optimizer at baseline and scored at reference level on both targets
lessons.implication: blacklist search-space reduction as a standalone quality lever on these targets
